class.name: PCKBuildPlan

members.member: One message per entry that can't be built: a delta patch, a [code]res://[/code] source whose target is not its source path, or a [code].import[/code], [code].remap[/code] or [code].uid[/code] entry listed without its source. For a null description, one message that says so. Nothing is built while this array is not empty.
The [code]res://[/code] sources that go through the export pipeline of the preset, in exported form for its platform. The target path of each is its source path without [code]res://[/code].
The pack paths of the entries copied as they are: entries with data in memory, with a source outside [code]res://[/code], and entries read from [member PCKPackage.base_pack].
The pack paths written as removal entries.

The pack paths of [code].import[/code], [code].remap[/code] and [code].uid[/code] entries that are not written from the description, because the export writes them for their source in [member export_sources].
[code]true[/code] if [member errors] is empty, so the description can be built.
